title: Not down alternative at all
text: Not down alternative at all. Nothing like a down pillow. Feels like a cheap overstuffed Walmart pillow. They hold their shape so they look good on my couch but they aren't very comfy. Came in a clear plastic bag in a large box -no vacuum packaging. Disappointed that they aren't really "down alternative" but you get what you pay for I guess!
